review.notes: All 18 physical pages scanned with a 5-gram PDF-text-to-OCR word-coverage pass; hyphenation artifacts (pre dic tion, represen tations) and LaTeX-equivalent math account for nearly all diffs. Reference section (34 entries, first A. Asai through last D. Zhu) and the B contributions table were compared against the printed lists with no drops found. Equations (1)-(3) on physical p.4 and the NeurIPS URL on physical p.12 were verified on 150-400 dpi renders. No code fences exist in the OCR and the heading hierarchy matches the printed sections.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.12 Kusupati reference prints the typewriter URL https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/... with a real underscore (verified on a 300 dpi crop); OCR inserted a Markdown escape.

Rendered physical p.4 equation (1) closes the second term with four parentheses (f(g(P(M_n(...))))) plus the sentence period; OCR transcribed five closing parentheses. Balanced-paren count on the rendered equation is 4 per term.

Rendered physical p.4 prose after equation (2) prints the indicator symbol in blackboard bold (double-stroke 1, subscript TN), matching the OCR's own display equation (3) which uses \mathbb {1}; the OCR inline prose dropped the blackboard styling and printed a plain numeral 1.
